claim: For \(q\ge2\), let \(W_q(y\mid x)=1/(q-1)\) when \(y\ne x\) and zero otherwise on \([q]\). In the common-randomness-assisted, fixed-codebook, worst-case total-variation model, the exact minimum codebook size for two independent uses is \(M_0^\star(W_q^{\otimes2})=4\) for \(q=2\) and \(M_0^\star(W_q^{\otimes2})=3\) for every \(q\ge3\).
